description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for the Smart Home TV app, hosting a sidebar for navigation between Dashboard and Settings fragments, managing focus states for TV remote navigation, and handling section switching with UI updates.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity acting as the entry point for the Smart Home TV app, managing UI navigation and focus.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, and focuses the initial sidebar item.

methods.name: roundedFocusBackground
methods.description: Creates a GradientDrawable for focus highlighting.

methods.name: setupSidebar
methods.description: Configures the sidebar UI, including focus and click behaviors for navigation items.

methods.name: showSection
methods.description: Switches the displayed fragment based on selected section and shows a Toast message.
